newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota lawmaker pushes college saver bond bill.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota lawmaker pushes college saver bond bill.

text.p: A Minnesota lawmaker has introduced a bill to create a college savings bond program.

State Rep. Lyndon Carlson, D-Crystal, said Wednesday his bill would direct the state's commissioner of finance to establish a program that would allow some of Minnesota's general obligation bonds to be sold in a zero-coupon form to residents saving for college expenses.
The so-called Gopher State Bonds would be exempt from state income taxes and would be sold in demoninations as small as $500, Carlson said.
Carlson, who chairs the House Education Committee, said he was "pretty optimistic" the measure would pass this year.
Last year, the measure passed the House but stalled in the Senate, he added.
